page.title: Guaranteed Summer Internship - Immediate Joining
page.visible_text: Congratulations! You have been selected for our exclusive Data Science Internship. Guaranteed salary of ₹80,000 monthly with no experience required. To confirm your selection, you must deposit a refundable registration fee of ₹2,500 immediately. Only 3 seats left! Offer expires in 2 hours. Send your Aadhaar card and PAN card to our Telegram recruiter @recruiter_hr.
